images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: bungalow | On

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a hipped (pyramid) cottage with a big hipped dormer and a full porch, on an open lot at the edge of town, snow (a faint, overexposed card)
